Beyond water samples, air samples were also collected. All air samples were removed for these visualizations. For surface samples, passive sampling using a TorpeDNA device (DNA is filtered as the device is towed through the water) was compared to active sampling (water is pumped mechanically through a filter on the boat to filter out DNA).
